# M20 Rotting Regisaur {2}{B} 7/6
# "At the beginning of your upkeep, discard a card."
# The compiler's upkeep frame (B13-upkeep: TurnPhaseEvent UPKEEP, actor CONTROLLER_IS YOU) with the
# discard step of B3-seq-draw-discard (MOVE_ZONE one CHOOSE card from your hand to your graveyard).
# Upkeep triggers resolve before the draw step since efa79c0 (CR 503.1a, 504).
abilities = [
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=TurnPhaseEvent(
            phase=Phase.UPKEEP,
            actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
        ),
        condition=None,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            ),
            'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        }),
    ),
    *compiled,
]
